title: Request an Azure landing zone
summary: Get an Azure subscription set up as a landing zone: governance approval, policies, networking and access for your team.

prerequisites.title: Data classification completed
prerequisites.description: The classification decides which policies apply.

prerequisites.title: Solution architecture approved
prerequisites.description: At least a high-level design reviewed by an architect.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The engineer or BA following this process.

actors.name: Landing zone pipeline
actors.description: Terraform pipeline that deploys landing zones.

steps.title: Complete the landing zone questionnaire
instructions: Choose the archetype: corp (internal network) or online (internet facing).
State the regions, environments and expected monthly spend.
List who needs Owner, Contributor and Reader access.

steps.title: Raise the 'Azure landing zone' request
instructions: Enter application ID and cost centre.
Attach the questionnaire and the architecture diagram.

steps.title: Review the request at the governance board
Rework the design
instructions: Read the board's comments in the request.
Update the questionnaire and the architecture diagram.
Resubmit for the next board meeting.

steps.title: Deploy the landing zone
steps.description: Creates the subscription, policies, network spoke and role assignments.

steps.title: Hand over the subscription
steps.description: You receive the subscription ID and a short guide by email.

steps.title: Check your access
instructions: Open the Azure portal and find the new subscription.
Check your team has the roles you asked for.
Deploy a test resource group to confirm policies allow it.
